baseline_findings.title: Potential XSS vulnerability in the '/api/upload' route
baseline_findings.description: The '/api/upload' route does not properly sanitize user input, which could lead to an XSS attack if an attacker can inject malicious scripts into the application.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The route does not have any input validation or sanitization measures in place for the uploaded files or metadata.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: input_validation; required control: Input validation and sanitization should be implemented for all user inputs to prevent XSS attacks.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Implement input validation and sanitization for all user inputs. This can include validating file types, sizes, and contents before processing them. Additionally, ensure that any output generated by the application is properly encoded to prevent XSS attacks.

baseline_findings.title: Potential SQL Injection vulnerability in the '/api/stripe' route
baseline_findings.description: The '/api/stripe' route does not properly sanitize user input, which could lead to an SQL injection attack if an attacker can inject malicious SQL code into the application.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The route does not use parameterized queries or prepared statements when interacting with the database, which could allow attackers to execute arbitrary SQL code.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: POST; required control: CWE-89: SQL Injection
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements when interacting with the database. This ensures that user inputs are treated as data and not executable code.

baseline_findings.title: Potential Broken Authentication vulnerability in the '/auth/facebook/callback' route
baseline_findings.description: The '/auth/facebook/callback' route does not properly validate the authentication response from Facebook, which could allow attackers to bypass authentication.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The route does not verify the authenticity of the authentication response from Facebook before granting access to the user.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: GET; required control: CWE-382: Broken Authentication
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Implement proper validation of the authentication response from Facebook. This could include verifying the signature of the response and checking that the response contains expected values.

baseline_findings.title: Potential Sensitive Data Exposure vulnerability in the '/api/stripe' route
baseline_findings.description: The '/api/stripe' route does not properly encrypt sensitive data, which could allow attackers to access sensitive information if they gain access to the application.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The route does not use encryption when transmitting sensitive data over the network.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: POST; required control: CWE-523: Sensitive Data Exposure
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Use encryption when transmitting sensitive data over the network. This could include using HTTPS to encrypt all communication between the client and server.
